messages:
arkadi: Heads up — nightly evals for quantized/xl-v2 on the new bring-up are spiking timeouts. 8/10 runs fail on sampling timebox.

ci-bot: nightly-eval-1977777 queued -> run 1977777 failed (timeout)

mira: Can you paste the failing log snippet?

arkadi: ```
[worker-3] INFO sample: starting gen
[worker-3] ERROR Timeout waiting for sample (20000ms)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/harness/runner.py", line 412, in sample_loop
    out = sampler.sample(batch)
TimeoutError: sample timed out
```

jack: This smells like RNG nondeterminism + worker starvation. Did we change seed handling in the harness? :thinking: 

sophia: We merged the cuDNN work — also set torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) in some tests earlier this week.

arkadi: No seed changes in harness, but the build that rolled to canary had a pip bump for numpy 1.26. CI logs show longer GC pauses on a few nodes.

mira: If it's GC or sysload, we should see it in perf metrics. @eng-oncall can you check agent load at 02:00 UTC when the run started?

jack: Quick workaround — increase sampling timebox from 20s -> 60s in the harness, but that's just masking.

mira: Agreed. Can we try bisecting between commit A..E? I'll kick a manual run with deterministic seed + single worker.

arkadi: Kicked a manual repro: run/1977777777-repro. Reproducer still times out even with seed pinned but only when parallel workers>1. Single worker OK.

sophia: That isolates it to inter-process KV cache or shared mmap. Recent change to mmap cleanup in 21a could be racing.

jack: Try `export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1` in worker env — reduces thread contention.

arkadi: Tried OMP trick — no dice. Uploading perf dumps and `/proc/<pid>/maps` to the thread: https://redwood/snap/1977777 :eyes: 

mira: I'll run a bisect with the mmap change reverted. If that reproduces, we have a good lead. Also adding a flaky-test ticket.

ci-bot: Perflogs attached to ticket RED-3881.

jack: Filing a follow-up: if mmap race, most likely fix is to serialize mmap unlink at worker teardown. I'll draft a patch.

mira: Thanks — moving to priority-high and pinging eng-sre for infra noise correlation. :white_check_mark:
